title: grace_ms overflow: gc_max_age_days * 24*60*60*1000 silent overflow for large values
description: main.rs line: let grace_ms = gc_max_age_days.saturating_mul(24 * 60 * 60 * 1000). gc_max_age_days is u64. 24*60*60*1000 = 86_400_000. For gc_max_age_days > 213503982334 the multiplication overflows u64. saturating_mul prevents wrapping but clips to u64::MAX, which means grace_period_ms passed to select_gc_candidates will be larger than now_ms, making cutoff_ms saturate to 0 and selecting ALL articles as GC candidates. An operator-specified max_age_days should be validated against a reasonable upper bound at config load time.
